title: Whispering Gallery Modes for Semilinear Dirichlet Eigenvalue Problems
summary: We study the boundary localization phenomenon, known as whispering gallery modes, for weak solutions to semilinear Dirichlet eigenvalue problems in the unit ball $B_1 \subseteq \mathbb{R}^d$ ($d \geq 2$) of the form \[ \begin{cases} -Δu + f(u) = λu & \text{in } B_1,\\ u = 0 & \text{on } \partial B_1. \end{cases} \] Here, $f = F'$ where $F$ is a nonnegative $C^2$-function with superquadratic polynomial growth. We prove the existence of a sequence of solutions $(u_n, λ_n)$ with $λ_n \to +\infty$ such that, for any $τ\in (0,1)$, \[ \lim_{n \to \infty} \frac{E_τ(u_n)}{E_1(u_n)} = 0, \] where…
